title: Weekly Gathering & Nutrition
summary: A weekly children's gathering brings shared meals and teaching together in Masoro.
heroText: A welcoming space to learn, share a meal, and grow together.
need: Children benefit from dependable opportunities to gather, share a meal, and learn in a caring community.
whatWeDo: Hold a weekly children's gathering in Masoro.
Teach moral values, positive attitudes, and politeness.
howItWorks: Children come together for fellowship, a shared meal, and teaching.
The gathering takes place weekly; its start date is shown in results below.
howToHelp: Support meals for the weekly gathering.
Help provide school shoes, school feeding fees, uniforms, and hygiene items.
